item.description: Experts say the symptoms can be wide-ranging and it's important to know what to look out for and where to go to help. It comes amid renewed calls for more support services for new parents. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lottie Twyford

item.title: Everything you need to know as Roos hunt historic AFLW three-peat
item.description: The Kangaroos are out to create a piece of AFLW history as they take on the Demons in this year's grand final. Here's everything you need to know ahead of the decider. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Three months after Nepal disaster, worshippers return to lost temple
item.description: Three months after devastating floods tore through communities in Nepal, survivors are still picking up the pieces. On the banks of the Trishuli River, worshippers return to the ruins of a Hindu temple to honour the dead. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Clayton and Bhat Burhan

item.title: Remote Australian community becoming a battleground for space race
item.description: A new Australian rocket company, RangeOz, is developing a separate rocket launch site about 5 kilometres away from the pre-existing Koonibba Test Range. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jenae Madden and Charlotte Martin

item.title: 17-year-old's website lets people send messages from beyond the grave
item.description: 17-year-old Alice Footer from Australia's Gold Coast has developed FromBeyond.co, a website that lets people record personal messages and schedule their delivery to loved ones on birthdays, Christmas and other occasions, even after their death. Inspired by her grandmother's stories and worried that younger family members might lose touch with their family's past, Alice created the platform to preserve memories for future generations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Aussie rugby sevens star driven to 'tick off' goal of Olympic gold
item.description: Australia has not claimed an Olympic title in rugby sevens since 2016, but Tia Hinds and her teammates are determined to climb the podium at the Los Angeles Games. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Luke Pentony

item.title: Concerns raised over use of smart glasses outside polling booths
item.description: An early polling booth in Victoria's west has been the subject of two incidents reported to the state's electoral commission, including the use of smart glasses by a One Nation volunteer. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nethma Dandeniya

item.title: Retired priest claims he witnessed sexual abuse inside church as victims come forward
item.description: Three former students allege they were assaulted by a parish priest, Father Paul Francis Cahill, at Our Lady of Dolours Catholic Church in Chatswood in the 1970s and 1980s. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Conor Duffy and Miwa Blumer

item.title: India's Pant joins New Zealand club match under false name
item.description: India wicketkeeper Rishabh Pant unexpectedly joins a club game in Christchurch before the second Test against New Zealand and scores 54 off 21 balls. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Australian court blocks plan to turn former coal power station into biomass plant that could power 200,000 homes
item.description: A court ruling in New South Wales upheld the denial of a biomass facility proposed by Verdant Earth Technologies. The project aimed to convert a coal-fired power station into a bioenergy hub, supplying electricity to 200,000 homes. Environmental groups opposed the project, fearing increased native vegetation clearing for fuel. Verdant Earth expressed surprise at the ruling and plans to consult its legal team for next steps. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Exclusive : Australian Electoral Commission to review $1m in donations to Pauline Hanson-led party from Adam Giles and Ian Plimer Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast Major donations from close associates of One Nation’s billionaire benefactor, Gina Rinehart, will be reviewed by the Australian Electoral Commission (AEC) amid concerns they were made on behalf of a third party. The special minister of state, Don Farrell, said on Thursday that information about two $500,000 donations made to the Pauline Hanson-led party could be subject to further regulatory action if… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: ‘Disaster’ unfolding as Sydney fire ant outbreak partly blamed on ignored biosecurity recommendations
item.description: Farmers’ federation president says Australia ‘can’t even keep [illicit] cigarettes out of the country … let alone some of these difficult-to-detect pests’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Years-old recommendations by Australia’s biosecurity watchdog have been ignored or not acted on by successive federal governments, increasing the risk of an invasive pest outbreak such as the fire ants discovered in Sydney this week, according to experts. Environmentalists and biosecurity experts warn the large colony of red imported fire ants are a warning sign that the country’s… Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment. item.description: Environment minister says he understands concerns about potential impact after 150 scientists and celebrities urged the government to block the project Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast The environment minister, Murray Watt, has acknowledged concerns raised by scientists and celebrity campaigners, including Hugh Jackman, about a contentious Woodside offshore gas proposal in northern Western Australia, saying he “absolutely understands” why they think it could have “very serious impacts” on nature. The federal government is expected to make a decision on whether to… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Singapore doctor remanded over filming 874 women in Melbourne: ‘abhorrent sexual predator’
item.description: A Singaporean trainee surgeon who secretly filmed hundreds of his female colleagues in Australian hospitals was remanded on Thursday. Ryan Cho, 29, will be sentenced on February 12 after he pleaded guilty to recording 874 women at three major Melbourne hospitals and shared houses, according to the Australian Broadcasting Corporation. The court heard that Cho used a phone hidden in a mesh bag to spy on women, meticulously cataloguing and storing the footage on his laptop. To get his victims to... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: SCMP’s Asia desk

item.title: UN experts demand Vietnam explain ‘abduction’ of activists from Cambodia
item.description: Vietnam must explain how three pro-democracy activists ended up in detention facing terrorism charges after being allegedly abducted from neighbouring Cambodia, United Nations experts said on Thursday. Vietnam permits little to no dissent within its borders and critics say its security apparatus stretches abroad, with wanted dissidents previously abducted in Thailand and Germany. The authorities in Hanoi confirmed in September they had arrested three men – an Australian, a Norwegian and a... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse

item.title: Many buyers willing to pay more to know where their food comes from
item.description: New research from Curtin University reveals many Australians are prepared to pay more for food when they know where it comes from and how animals are treated, despite ongoing cost-of-living pressures. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Will Solomon Islands’ Australia treaty prompt China to rethink its Pacific strategy?
item.description: The Solomon Islands’ decision to replace its 2022 security pact with China with a sweeping new Australian treaty may push Beijing to rethink its Pacific playbook, observers say. While some analysts said Honiara’s pivot reflected hard-nosed domestic pragmatism rather than a regional rush to shut out Beijing, others warned that Beijing must be wary of Canberra using the pact as a foothold to extend exclusive demands from security into economic and development ties. The assessment was made as the... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Laura Zhou

item.title: Deep beneath Australia, hidden caves could unlock the secrets of alien worlds
item.description: Scientists have solved the mystery of strange trenches scattered across Australia’s vast Nullarbor Plain, revealing an extensive hidden world beneath the surface. These subtle landscape features are created as deeply buried cave systems slowly collapse upward over millions of years. The discovery could help researchers locate unexplored caves containing ancient environmental records and unusual life forms. Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: Flight Centre investigating mass cyber breach
item.description: The travel agency has apologised as it investigates a cyber breach believed to have exposed a significant number of customer records, including passport details. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jeremy Cook

item.title: Wildfires raze homes, displace wildlife on Australian island
item.description: Wildfires have forced road closures, displaced animals and razed homes while engulfing over 10% of Australia's southeastern Flinders Island, emergency services said Thursday. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Ex-Cricket Australia boss James Sutherland defends ‘Sandpapergate’ probe
item.description: Meanwhile, David Warner denies a broadcaster's claim that he used superglue and grit to tamper with the ball. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Politics and peek-a-boo in Australian parliament as senator brings baby to work
item.description: Senator Lidia Thorpe kept 6-month-old Aaliyah entertained, as her mum Senator Fatima Payman, participated in an online safety bill debate. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.description: The Support at Home system has ‘baffling’ bureaucracy and ‘rations and denies care’, says Greens chair of Senate inquiry Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast Many older Australians are dying before they can access home support, paying exorbitant fees, and being pushed into hospitals and residential care before they are ready because of a flawed federal government aged care program, a Senate inquiry has found . item.title: Report finds Support at Home co-payments should be reviewed
item.description: The amount older Australians contribute to Support at Home services should be reviewed and clinicians should be able to override the assessment algorithms, a parliamentary committee recommends. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Ipswich councillor Andrew Antoniolli is ordered to make a public apology for saying a female contractor was part of the "school short-skirt brigade". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Almost 300 home buyers were waiting to get the keys to their newly-built apartments in Sydney's Dee Why and Blacktown. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Lee stars despite missing club after lesson with F1 stars
item.description: Min Woo Lee shoots a four-under par 68 despite being left without his eight-iron for the first round of the Australian PGA Championship after he gave a golf lesson to Formula 1 stars Carlos Sainz and Lance Stroll. Fuente: BBC Sport.
